blockers.finding: Authoritative GitHub reports main protected=false with branch protection disabled and no required status-check contexts.
blockers.requiredResolution: Protect the authoritative default branch with the applicable pull-request, required-check, exact-head/up-to-date, force-push, deletion, and auditable-bypass controls required by GoreeCloud repository governance, then verify the live host state.

blockers.finding: Exact-candidate OSV and CycloneDX evidence is now available for the governed V1.6 security-review branch. The reviewed baseline records 50 distinct dependency vulnerability advisories across 1,104 scanned Maven package entries and 507 SBOM components, with 20 vulnerable coordinates in build tooling/reference-build dependency state and 0 matches in the three recorded debugRuntimeClasspath reports. Build tooling remains in scope under Stable Release Security Blockers v1.0, so these findings remain release-blocking pending remediation or an authorized evidence-backed disposition.
blockers.requiredResolution: Remediate the affected build-tool dependency graph, or establish a narrow authorized exception/non-applicability disposition under Stable Release Security Blockers v1.0 and the Security Updates and Vulnerability Management standard, then rerun exact-candidate security evidence.

blockers.finding: A governed V1.6 Stable security review now exists and passes the secret/Git-history sub-gate, but its overall decision remains blocked because dependency and supply-chain findings are unresolved.
blockers.requiredResolution: Close the dependency/supply-chain findings or record an authorized narrow exception, then update the exact-candidate Stable security acceptance record so every applicable control is Passed, Not Applicable with justification, or Excepted with approved evidence.

blockers.finding: The Release Candidate is source-qualified, but the exact Stable artifact/package/publication boundary, checksum/SBOM/provenance requirements, and final immutable release identity have not yet been established and accepted for V1.6 Stable.
blockers.requiredResolution: Define the supported Stable distribution artifact or source-release boundary, bind it to the exact approved source, generate applicable checksum/SBOM/provenance/signing evidence, and perform the controlled release transition only after all prior blockers close.
